title: The Perfect Killer
description: Mila and her stepdaughter find out that the fatal shooting of her husband was linked to an AI voice scam. When Mila is later attacked by an unknown assailant, she soon starts to wonder if the killer is someone close to them.

description: Fifteen-year-old Heather Robinson's world comes crashing down when the man she knew as her uncle, John Robinson, is arrested for the murders of multiple women in the Kansas City area, including her biological mother.
